headline: Saving is choosing future over present—keeping resources now to have options later
universal_truth: Present sacrifice creates future freedom; what you save becomes what you can choose
fun_facts: Compound interest has been called the eighth wonder of the world—money grows money
Saving isn't just about money—you can save time, energy, and resources
People who automate saving do it more consistently than those who decide each time
discussion_questions: How do you balance present enjoyment with future security?
What would you do differently if you had more saved?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Spend everything now and have nothing for later. Save everything and miss living now. The balance between present consumption and future security is one of life's essential tensions. Saving is choosing to have options tomorrow.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Why not just spend now and figure out later when it comes?

options.text: Saving creates freedom and security—unexpected needs arise, opportunities appear, emergencies happen; what you've saved becomes your ability to respond rather than react; saving is buying future options
options.response: Yes. Life is unpredictable. Savings buffer against the unexpected and enable the desirable. Without reserves, you're dependent on everything going right. Savings buy resilience.
Eventually yes, but saved resources can grow, and having them gives you choices you wouldn't otherwise have...

q1.title: Time Multiplies
q1.script: Saved resources can grow. Interest compounds. Skills deepen. Investments appreciate. Starting earlier means more time for growth. Small savings begun early often outperform large savings begun late.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Time Multiplies"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Automatic Works
q2.script: Willpower is limited. Deciding to save every time depletes you. Automating savings removes the decision—the money moves before you can spend it. Systems beat intentions.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Beyond Money
q3.script: Saving applies beyond money. Save energy for important tasks. Save time by not overcommitting. Save attention for what matters. The principle of reservation applies everywhere.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Present sacrifice creates future freedom. What you save becomes what you can choose. Keep something for later.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 341. Tomorrow, we'll explore choosing what to buy—consumer decisions. Until then, consider what you're saving and why.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Savings Check - What Are You Keeping?
growTrack.activity: What are you currently saving—money, time, energy? Is it automatic or deliberate each time? What would having more saved enable? Set up one automated saving system if you haven't.
